about: The handles a member answers to, in the order they are tried: the cases TestHandlesOrderMatchesTheComposer (internal/domain/mentions, mentions.Handles) and the note composer's mentionHandles (frontend/src/components/noteMentions.test.ts) share, so neither keeps a copy of the other's (refactor plan X4b). The composer writes the first handle the server's @([\w.-]+) pattern captures whole, so the two lists must agree: a handle it writes that the server does not answer to is a mention that names nobody. why says what the case shows; handles is the list both give for name and email.

cases.why: offers the name without spaces, the first name, then the email local part
cases.name: Dana Okoro

cases.why: skips the name when there is none
skips the email when it is not one
cases.name: Dana Okoro

cases.why: keeps an apostrophe, which the pattern stops at, so the composer writes the next handle instead
cases.name: Ciara O'Brien
